_comment: Hand-maintained — the backup script reads this file and never rewrites it.
Maps a field label recorded on older observations to the current field it
should be merged into for the CSV extracts. Only needed where the merge
needs human judgement: name variants that differ merely in case,
automatically and must not be listed here.
Sections are keyed by datasheet directory slug or datasheet name; '*'
applies to every datasheet in this project. Entries here win over the
automatic rules. Each datasheet's README.md lists any legacy field left
unmerged, with candidate targets to choose from.
